## Description {#details}

<p>Class to represent target extensions types, which are generally unintrospectable from target-independent optimizations.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/target">Target</a> extension types have a string name, and optionally have type and/or integer parameters. The exact meaning of any parameters is dependent on the target.</p>
